name: InMoment
oneLiner: Enterprise customer experience platform combining surveys, online review and reputation management, social listening and AI text and conversation analytics; part of PG Forsta since 2025.
bestFor: Large multi-location restaurant brands and franchise systems that want guest surveys, reviews and contact-center feedback analyzed together, with location-level reporting.

updates.text: Acquired by Press Ganey Forsta (PG Forsta); terms not disclosed. InMoment continues as a brand, 'InMoment, a PG Forsta company'.
Launched AI Auto Responding for reviews, which writes replies from each review's sentiment and the brand's guidelines and can post them directly or queue them for approval.

features: Post-visit surveys by email, SMS, web and app, triggered after a guest interaction
Review monitoring and response across Google and other review sites from one dashboard
AI-written review replies, posted automatically or sent for approval
AI text analytics that surface themes, sentiment and intent across all feedback
Conversation analytics for contact-center calls and chats
Location, region and brand dashboards for comparing guest scores
Frontline reporting that shows each location's top positive and negative drivers
Social listening alongside survey and review data
notes: Acquired by PG Forsta in May 2025; the product is still sold under the InMoment name. No 2026 product announcement found. Customer stories are vendor-published and some are older (Jack in the Box expanded its use of InMoment's AI analytics in June 2023). Other restaurant stories found but not checked in detail: McDonald's Australia, Pizza Hut, Solotel Group, Betty's Burgers. Vendor figures not used (e.g. 43,000 clients, Melting Pot '47% speed-of-service' increase). Current review's positioning holds; nothing specific to drop beyond adding the acquisition.
